scope: Fixed finalized-state reader and narrow RPC whitelist/parameter extension, using actual retained native public state/full compiled decoder and controlled RPC. This is source correctness only, not live node support or ledger nonmutation.

findings.title: Successful finalized-state capture can return after the shared absolute deadline
findings.evidence: With actual retained full-build loader and native initialized swap state, controlled final chain_getBlockHash occupied the event loop until deadlineMs+20 then returned the correct hash. captureFinalizedFinancialState returned a success record 21ms after deadline. Promise.race timer cannot fire while the operation holds the event loop; its resolved operation wins once released, and the reader performs no post-await deadline check before returning.
findings.expected: An observation completed after the shared deadline must reject or remain unknown, even if the RPC operation began before the deadline and its final data is otherwise valid.
findings.requestedRepair: Add an explicit post-await absolute-deadline check at the reader success boundary and a regression that occupies the event loop through deadline during the last canonical query. Keep native cleanup and existing unknown/deadline classifications. A broad rewrite of the shared observation wrapper is not required for this focused repair.

verifiedObservations: All15 combined candidate hashes and all11 input/source plus8 historical check hashes and sizes match. Frozen candidate bytes rechecked after review and tests.
23 reader/RPC tests and88 targeted integration regressions pass, zero skipped; their current coverage does not include the delayed-timer success counterexample.

The public Rust RPC source declares contract address and optional historical block hash, executes state API at that exact supplied hash and hex-encodes result. Current local-service support remains unobserved.

Reader uses explicit finalized head, header height and canonical mapping before/after decode; no implicit latest/indexer fallback. Later head advancement does not invalidate recorded as-of anchor or establish no intervening actions.

The exact SDK Compact-runtime state producer is used, native full serialization roundtrip checked, unsupported shielded balances rejected, native unshielded balance projection retained and complete generated getter-backed state detached with structuredClone. Native object freed in finally after successful deserialize and on roundtrip failure.

Caller-supplied already-bound address and verified loader remain trusted identity inputs; reader does not authenticate state proof, contract code identity or arbitrary replacement decoder. Documentation states these limits.
RPC addition permits only midnight_contractState with exact bare64hex address and mandatory0x64hex block. Existing read-only method whitelist and no retries retained.
Transport ceiling is64KiB JSON body, necessarily stricter than1MiB decoded-state cap; documented, not silently expanded.
Required build environment fails when absent; no install/rebuild/proof/network/service/private-state action ran in this review.
